purpose: Select a shared, reward-blind warm start with enough independent route and digit support to power the unchanged Stage C3 credit-confusion gate.

stage_c3_v3_terminal_record.failure_class: The exact pre-arm power gate measured insufficient root-route support at the inherited initialization.
stage_c3_v3_terminal_record.accepted_disposition: Terminal underpowered design; Stage C3 v3 remains closed and is never retried.
stage_c3_v3_terminal_record.threshold_policy: The initialization changes. Every failed v3 exact-power threshold remains unchanged.

factorized_dataset.construction: Eight balanced root-only examples plus the complete 4-route by 8-digit Cartesian product in separate target-only examples.

initialization.selection_training_model: The inherited adapter is first merged into the named base model in BF16, then one new LoRA is trained against that exact deployed initialization.

sft.one_run_rule: After the first optimizer step, do not rerun SFT, change the corpus, change hyperparameters, or train replacement candidates.

candidate_selection.rule: Select the earliest ascending optimizer checkpoint satisfying every frozen check; later checkpoints are not consulted.
candidate_selection.no_passing_candidate: Record a terminal Stage C4 selection failure, run no RL campaign, recover compact artifacts, and do not retry this selection.

authoritative_scoring.model_form: BF16 merged model, never runtime-LoRA scores
authoritative_scoring.engine: The same pinned vLLM installation and model-loading mode used by the campaign.
authoritative_scoring.action_measurement: Exact full-vocabulary next-token probabilities retempered analytically.
authoritative_scoring.root_measurement: Exact complete route-sequence probabilities, including EOS.
authoritative_scoring.factorization_measurement: Measure route-conditioned normalized digit distributions on all four exact campaign prefixes and require both TV and mutual-information bounds.

unchanged_v3_power_gate.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true and separators=(',', ':')
unchanged_v3_power_gate.policy: Every v3 exact-power check remains mandatory and byte-identical; selection adds stricter margins but changes no campaign threshold.

separation.campaign_freeze_condition: A selected adapter hash, merged-model manifest, complete support report, and selection terminal record are local before any v4 RL model call.

pre_model_call_checks: Verify every frozen source and data hash.
Run the root Stage C4 tests and the affected Prime environment/dispatcher tests.
Parse the SFT configuration through Prime-RL SFTConfig.
Verify the expected external Prime patch reverse-applies.
Run the frozen selection preregistration audit.
execution.failure_handling: After any optimizer step or model scoring call, any failure is terminal for this selection. Recover all existing compact artifacts and do not retry.
execution.local_artifact_policy: Keep exact scores, manifests, signatures, logs, reports, and only the selected adapter. Do not sync intermediate adapters, merged 4B models, optimizer states, or redundant full-model shards.
execution.remote_cleanup: Remove each rejected merged candidate before scoring the next. Delete all remaining merged models and intermediate adapters at pod teardown.
execution.teardown: Always terminate compute after artifact recovery and confirm zero persistent disks.

hardware.availability_observed: 2026-07-29 before freeze: resource 6705b0 was listed Available at $1.64/hour; no eligible 2x48GB A40, A6000, RTX 6000 Ada, or RTX 8000 offering was listed.
hardware.fallback_rule: Do not silently substitute hardware. If resource 6705b0 is unavailable before the first model call, commit a hardware-only amendment and repeat the hash audit.
hardware.ssh_rule: Verify SSH noninteractively immediately after provisioning; terminate without model calls if it fails.

validation.known_unrelated_full_mypy_findings: 13 pre-existing missing generic annotations in six older Stage C test files.
